title: Debt collection industry
summary: This page provides information about the debt collection industry and the requirements for obtaining and managing a commercial agent licence.
who_can_apply: Must be involved in debt collection activities in NSW.
what_you_need: Depending on the type of licence (individual/sole trader, corporation, or mutual recognition), you will need to follow the specific application process.

faqs.q: What is a commercial agent licence?
faqs.a: A commercial agent licence is required if you are involved in debt collection activities in NSW.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a commercial agent licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a licence depending on whether you are an individual/sole trader, a corporation, or applying under mutual recognition.

faqs.q: What if I need to change or renew my licence?
faqs.a: You can change details, renew, restore, or replace your licence through specific online services.
